name: VersionDetail
title: Templates/Platform/Detail/VersionDetail
summary: One version of a resource, opened from its Versions tab, as a page body for ConsoleLayout: the layout's last crumb is a transparent select that switches between the resource versions, each with its state Tag, or creates a new one (the page sets it with `ConsoleLayout.Breadcrumbs`; below md the body's own row carries it with a Back button); the root carries `data-layout-fill`, so the layout's main gives the workspace the height under the header. In the body a horizontal `Resizable` holds the version workspace, a tab bar with Settings, Source, Variables, Cache Settings, Custom Code and Rules carrying the state Tag and a Version actions menu, the open tab in a fading `ScrollArea`, and the version bar pinned to the bottom that names the state and holds the Save and deploy `SplitButton` on a draft or Add Version and Redeploy on a built version, and a collapsible Version history pane with the current version, its changes and the earlier built versions. The stories open on the Settings tab; the Rules tab is the Edit/RuleBuilder template, and the Source, Variables, Cache Settings and Custom Code panels are not plotted here. Built from `ConfirmDialog`, `Toaster`, `PageHeader`, `PageTabs`, `SettingsSection`, `SettingRow`, `Select`, `Resizable`, `Tabs`, `Tag`, `DropdownMenu`, `ScrollArea`, `Card`, `Item`, `Input`, `Switch`, `SplitButton`, `Button`, `Avatar`, `Field` and `Textarea`.

variants.name: Deployed
variants.summary: The deployed version, read-only: the creation date beside the Deployed Tag, the settings fieldset disabled, and the version bar reading Viewing a deployed version and Read-only with its description, Add Version and Redeploy.

variants.name: VersionHistory
variants.summary: The draft with Version history open beside it: the current version with its description, author and the pencil that edits it in place, the empty changes entry, and the five newest earlier versions with Show older for the rest.

variants.name: Revert
variants.summary: An earlier Ready version opened from Version history, read-only, the history pane open with the entry marked Viewing. The version bar reads Viewing an earlier version and offers Add Version and a primary Revert to AK7D0ZX4, which opens a `ConfirmDialog` with the diff against the deployed version: each changed setting from its old value to the new one, the rules added and removed, and that the deployed version stays in history. Confirm runs the revert as an async action: one toast turns from Reverting to AK7D0ZX4… into the outcome with Edit and Redeploy, and the version's Tag becomes Deployed.

variants.name: EnvironmentCrumb
variants.summary: The same version page reached from an environment: the trail reads Resources, the resource, then two `Select` crumbs (the page's `ConsoleLayout.Breadcrumbs` from md up, the body's own row below md). The environment crumb searches the environments, tags each with its deployment policy and offers Add Environment at its foot; picking one moves the version crumb to the version that environment serves. The version crumb marks each version with the environments it is live in, beside its state `Tag`.
